scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Türk sohbet Oyunu Script Bu L7NON v.1",
    LoadingTitle = "Yükleniyor...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "L7NON Rayfield GUI",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    Discord = { Enabled = false }
})

-- Ana Menü sekmesi
local Tab1 = Window:CreateTab("Ana Menü")

Tab1:CreateLabel("Hangi oyun için bilgi")
Tab1:CreateLabel("Oyun isim: Türk Sohbet Oyunu")
Tab1:CreateLabel("Oyun id: 109683700524361")

Tab1:CreateButton({
    Name = "Oyun için tıkla",
    Callback = function()
        local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        TeleportService:Teleport(109683700524361, player)
    end,
})

-- Oyuncu listesi sekmesi
local Tab2 = Window:CreateTab("Oyuncu listesi ⚫")

-- Speed bypass butonu
Tab2:CreateButton({
    Name = "Speed bypass (Çalışıyor)",
    Callback = function()
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50
        
        -- Loop ile hız sabit tutulacak
        spawn(function()
            while true do
                if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                    player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50
                end
                wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end,
})

-- Boombox eline al tıkla butonu
Tab2:CreateButton({
    Name = "Boombox eline al tıkla",
    Callback = function()
        local args = {
            [1] = "PlaySong",
            [2] = 98916879722665
        }
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("RADYO") and player.Character.RADYO:FindFirstChild("Remote") then
            player.Character.RADYO.Remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
        else
            warn("RADYO veya Remote bulunamadı!")
        end
    end,
})-- Char me 👤 butonu

-- 12. Türk Şarkı id menü
local turkSarkiMenuAcik = false
local turkSarkiMenu

Tab2:CreateButton({
    Name = "Türk Şarkı id menü",
    Callback = function()
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        
        if turkSarkiMenuAcik then
            if turkSarkiMenu then
                turkSarkiMenu:Destroy()
                turkSarkiMenu = nil
            end
            turkSarkiMenuAcik = false
            return
        end

        turkSarkiMenuAcik = true

        turkSarkiMenu = Instance.new("ScreenGui", gui)
        turkSarkiMenu.Name = "TurkSarkiMenu"

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame", turkSarkiMenu)
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 150)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -75)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.Active = true
        frame.Draggable = true

        local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
        closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
        closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
        closeBtn.Text = "X"
        closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            turkSarkiMenu:Destroy()
            turkSarkiMenuAcik = false
        end)

        local songIds = {
            "rbxassetid://132283850926090",
            "rbxassetid://128760870628477",
            "rbxassetid://115948029961218"
        }

        for i, id in ipairs(songIds) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 35 + (i-1)*35)
            btn.Text = id
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local args = {
                    [1] = "PlaySong",
                    [2] = tonumber(string.match(id, "%d+"))
                }
                local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
                if character and character:FindFirstChild("RADYO") and character.RADYO:FindFirstChild("Remote") then
                    character.RADYO.Remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
                else
                    warn("RADYO veya Remote bulunamadı!")
                end
            end)
        end
    end,
})

-- 16. ANTİ AFK LEVEL KASMA (Zıplama sistemi)
local ziplamayiBaslat = false
local jumpingLoop

Tab2:CreateButton({
    Name = "ANTİ AFK LEVEL KASMA",
    Callback = function()
        ziplamayiBaslat = not ziplamayiBaslat
        if ziplamayiBaslat then
            jumpingLoop = task.spawn(function()
                while ziplamayiBaslat do
                    local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                        char.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end)
        else
            if jumpingLoop then
                task.cancel(jumpingLoop)
            end
        end
    end,
})

-- 17. BACKDOOR V1 menü
Tab2:CreateButton({
    Name = "BACKDOOR V1",
    Callback = function()
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
        gui.Name = "BackdoorMenu"

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 150)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -75)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
        frame.Active = true
        frame.Draggable = true

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        title.Text = "BACKDOOR L7NON TÜRK SOHBET SCRİPT İÇİN"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        title.TextSize = 16

        local calistirBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
        calistirBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
        calistirBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
        calistirBtn.Text = "ÇALIŞTIR"
        calistirBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        calistirBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        calistirBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        calistirBtn.TextSize = 18
        calistirBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0

        calistirBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for _, v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    pcall(function()
                        if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            v:FireServer()
                        elseif v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            v:InvokeServer()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end,
})

    Name = "Boombox spam ses",

            spamLoop = task.spawn(function()
                while spamBoombox do
                    local args1 = {
                        [1] = "PlaySong",
                        [2] = 126477047038656
                    }
                    local args2 = {
                        [1] = "PlaySong",
                        [2] = 98916879722665
                    }
                    local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                    local char = plr.Character
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild("RADYO") then
                        pcall(function()
                            char.RADYO.Remote:FireServer(unpack(args1))
                            char.RADYO.Remote:FireServer(unpack(args2))
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end)
        else
            if spamLoop then
                task.cancel(spamLoop)
            end
        end
    end,
})
